integrity: Analytical infinite-family proof with standalone exact rational finite checks; no finite check is treated as proof of infinite claims.
scientific_limitations: Only unweighted complete multipartite combinatorial Laplacians, all class sizes >=2, theta in [0,1], and full end-step positivity. Potential equivalent unindexed formulas; no independent audit.
title: Exact theta-step positivity horizons on complete multipartite diffusion networks
